IMP_EMAIL_INTRO: Not every soldier has to come from a catalogue. Our personality profiling site turns you into a field-ready recruit, measured against the same standards as the professionals you would otherwise have to hire at a premium.

Answer a set of questions about how you think, how you fight and how you treat the people beside you. There are no trick questions, only honest ones, and nobody but you and our analysts will ever read the answers.

We measure your strengths and your weaknesses without flattery. A good profile tells your team what you can carry, where you will need a hand and which jobs are better left to someone with a steadier nerve.

Then we write up a report your squad can rely on: temperament, attitude, the skills you bring to the table and the ones you will still have to learn in the field, the hard way if nobody teaches you first.

The service is quick and private. You pay once, when the profile is complete, and the recruit it describes joins your team on the next scheduled flight, equipped with the basic kit every new hand receives.

Bring patience and a sense of humour. The questionnaire takes a few minutes, the evaluation takes a night, and the results are mailed to you the next morning in plain words that anyone on the team can follow.

Several clients have told us the report surprised them. Most of them took the surprise well; the rest learned something useful about themselves and, as far as we know, are still alive to be grateful for it.

Visit the profiling site from your laptop bookmarks. The bookmark appears as soon as you have read this message, so there is nothing to type, nothing to remember and no excuse to put the decision off any longer.
MERC_INTRO: Our agency opens its doors to new clients this week.
We offer soldiers on daily contracts and fair prices.
Pay as you go, settle your account, keep your people happy.
OLD_ENRICO_1: You have heard the rumours. The country needs outside help, and the money is real.
Hire a team, land them in the north and start taking the land back one sector at a time.
OLD_ENRICO_2: The account is open in your name. Spend it wisely: every day of a contract costs money.
The mines can pay for the war once they are in friendly hands.
RIS_REPORT: Enemy patrols are thin near the coast and heavy around the capital. Expect resistance to stiffen as you advance.
OLD_ENRICO_3: The laptop links you to the hiring sites and your bank. Use it often.
Write back when your team has landed. We are counting on you.
